messages:
kai: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: sales pipeline + partners. Two fast asks from AEs.
kai: 1) How to tag inbound trials in SFDC (POC vs Opportunity)? 2) What are the partner pilot economics & registration steps?
rowan: Inbound trials = POC until there's a signed PO or active subscription. Don't count POCs toward commit.
rowan: Add a "POC expected close" date field and use the SFDC POC record type.
mia: Partner pilot summary: registered partners only, 10% co-sell credit for Q2 pilot, no retro credits. Registration via the partner form in #partners.
mia: Partner Ops will run weekly office hours starting next Wed to review registrations and deal regs.
kai: For AE enablement: can someone drop a one-line pitch and a 1-page battlecard we can paste into sequences?
rowan: Draft pitch: "Redwood: predictable LLM inference — start hosted, upgrade to Dedicated for SLA-backed throughput and data isolation." Short battlecard incoming.
sales-ops: Sales Ops will own the co-sell calc and quote template; Eng Infra will provide GPU sizing inputs for Dedicated quotes.
ops-bot: Recording & docs uploaded -> https://redwood.co/all-hands/1795012345
kai: Action items recap: 1) Mia: publish partner pilot doc + office hours invite; 2) Rowan: battlecard + SFDC field config; 3) Sales Ops: calc sheet + quote template. React with :white_check_mark: when done.
mia: :white_check_mark: doc + office hours calendar posted.
rowan: :white_check_mark: battlecard draft in #sales.
sales-ops: :white_check_mark: calc sheet shared.
kai: Thanks team — closing thread. Ping me for handoffs. :v:
